title: GitHub search results for PackedScene compatibility issues in Godot engine
key_points: The search found 116 total results related to PackedScene compatibility issues in the Godot engine.
Some of the issues are about crashes or unexpected behavior when loading scenes using the OpenGL compatibility renderer on Android.
A pull request suggests duplicating modified properties when instantiating packed scenes to avoid sharing references with the base PackedScene.
Another issue reports that Shape2D resources loaded via resource_local_to_scene are not duplicated by Node.duplicate(), which may cause unexpected behavior.
limitations: The results are limited to issues and pull requests tagged with 'PackedScene' or related terms, so there might be other compatibility issues not covered in this search.
Without further analysis, it's hard to determine the overall impact of these issues on Godot engine's compatibility.
asserts: The GitHub search results indicate that there are multiple reported compatibility issues related to PackedScene functionality in the Godot engine, particularly concerning Android platform and OpenGL compatibility renderer.
scope: The scope of this source is limited to the specific issues and pull requests tagged with 'PackedScene' or related terms within the Godot engine repository on GitHub.
